notes:
One voice per character, page after page.

Read-along used to decide who was speaking one page at a time, so when the camera flipped, a character's voice swapped with them. Casting now follows a conversation across the whole chapter and holds each character's voice for as long as the scene lasts.

• A sentence drawn across two balloons stays in one voice, the way it was lettered.
• When the page genuinely doesn't say who's speaking, it reads in your chosen voice instead of guessing.
• Narrator mode is one voice for the story and one for the talking — always.
